description: This line plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the absolute mean values of three different hidden state metrics across layers in a neural network architecture. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," spans from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks appearing at regular intervals of five units, indicating a linear scale without explicit unit labeling. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4 and uses a linear scale. The plot contains three distinct lines: the blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts near 0.0, fluctuates slightly between approximately 0.2 and 0.4 through layers 0 to 20, and then rises sharply to approximately 4.0 near layer 22; the orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate," which remains consistently near 0.0 across all layers; and the green solid line represents the "hidden state," which stays nearly flat at 0.0 through layer 20 before rising slightly to approximately 0.1 near layer 22.
